task: Assign six workers numbered 1 through 6 bijectively to six jobs numbered 1 through 6, minimising total cost. Matrix rows are workers, columns jobs: [[17, 9, 24, 14, 21, 12], [13, 22, 8, 19, 11, 25], [20, 15, 18, 7, 23, 10], [11, 24, 13, 22, 8, 16], [26, 12, 9, 17, 15, 20], [8, 19, 21, 13, 16, 11]]. Worker 1 cannot take job 2. Worker 4 cannot take job 5. Exactly two workers must receive their same-numbered job. Workers 2 and 5 must receive jobs of opposite parity. Return the minimum total cost as the final integer.
verification_method: exhaustive finite enumeration; exact integer equality
